free_tier.stated: Lightweight Core - Free. Included resources: Build Time: 15 hours per month, Backup Storage: 5 GB, Egress Traffic: 100 GB per month.

egress.terms: Lightweight Core - Free: Egress Traffic: 100 GB per month.; ingress: tcp+udp
egress.free_allowance: Lightweight Core - Free: Egress Traffic: 100 GB per month.

interface_detail: GUI, import YAML, and a REST API; "Direct Port Access ... Protocols: TCP, UDP".
tooling: wg-quick on the service; the port is configured in the Zerops GUI or import YAML.
chaining: Zerops direct UDP port plus a wg-quick peer gives a tunnel endpoint; the 100 GB/month cap means it carries control traffic and fallback, not bulk transfer.

limits.value: 100 GB per month on the Lightweight Core

binding_note: At 1 TiB/month the free core's 100 GB/month egress is exceeded 11 times over; extra egress is $0.02/GB. The port itself costs nothing.

identity_cost.detail: Sign up at app.zerops.io; "You get $15 in promo credits on signup, no credit card needed." Verifying with a $10 payment is optional and adds $50.

reliability_note: Firewall rules are per port, blacklist or whitelist. No ban or throttle documented for direct ports.
confidence_note: A live UDP probe of a Zerops direct port, sending a WireGuard handshake and reading the reply, would raise this to measured.

evidence.proved: Direct Port Access: port range 10-65435, protocols TCP and UDP, IPv6 first or Unique IPv4 add-on
Lightweight Core - Free includes 100 GB per month egress; Dedicated IPv4 $3.00 per month; extra egress $0.02 per GB
$15 in promo credits on signup, no credit card needed

notes: The only named provider whose free tier carries raw UDP to a public address. Caveats: IPv4 needs the $3/month add-on, so the free path is IPv6-only, and the container must be running (a WG endpoint is always-on, so it consumes the free core continuously).

extras.wg_detail: Direct Port Access: any port 10-65435, Protocols: TCP, UDP, mapped to an internal service port. wg-quick listens on that external port. IPv6 works without an add-on; a Unique IPv4 address is a $3.00/month add-on.
extras.volume_stated: Lightweight Core - Free: Egress Traffic: 100 GB per month.
extras.transit_note: Zerops public ingress carries the datagrams to the runtime container.
